lines.en: I hop with each step, almost dancing.

lines.zh: 粉色皮肤在瓦砾上很显眼。
lines.en: My pink skin stands out on the rubble.

lines.zh: 我飘一截，落地，再飘一截。
lines.en: I drift, land, drift again.

lines.zh: 肚子空空的，走路都没劲。
lines.en: My belly's empty; even walking feels weak.

lines.zh: 我把脚抬高，故意踩出响声。
lines.en: I lift my feet high and stomp loudly on purpose.

lines.zh: 这条街太窄，我肩膀擦着墙。
lines.en: The street's too narrow; my shoulders brush the walls.

lines.zh: 我歪歪扭扭地走，快摔又没摔。
lines.en: I wobble along, nearly falling, never falling.

lines.zh: 我一路把挡路的东西推倒。
lines.en: I knock down whatever's in my way.
Every couple of steps, I spin.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石，脚下嘎吱响。
lines.en: I crunch over the gravel.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有人，就朝那边去。
lines.en: I hear someone far off and head that way.

lines.zh: 这身子太软，走路没个正形。
lines.en: This body's too soft; my walk has no proper shape.
I sit on the rubble, swinging my legs.
My stomach growls; I press a hand to it.

lines.zh: 我拉了拉自己的一缕头触。
lines.en: I tug at one of my head tendrils.
No candy here. Disappointing.
I hum a tune with no shape to it.

lines.zh: 我把自己的一条手臂拉长又松开。
lines.en: I stretch one arm long, then let it snap back.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，想你是什么味道。
lines.en: Head tilted, I wonder what you taste like.

lines.zh: 等得无聊，我数自己的手指。
lines.en: Bored of waiting, I count my fingers.

lines.zh: 我拍拍身上的灰，越拍越多。
lines.en: I dust myself off and only spread more dust.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，嘴巴张得很大。
lines.en: I yawn, mouth opening very wide.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我在想吃的。
lines.en: When it's quiet, I think about food.

lines.zh: 我把头靠在断墙上，凉凉的。
lines.en: I lean my head on a broken wall; it's cool.

lines.zh: 我把手臂拉过屋梁，再收回来。
lines.en: I stretch an arm over the roof beam and pull it back.
Nobody to play with. How dull.
You're here! I've waited a long time.

lines.zh: 你能跟我玩吗？就一会儿。
lines.en: Will you play with me? Just a little while.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，肚子又响了。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you; my stomach growls again.
You smell nice, like candy.

lines.zh: 别怕，我不会一下子吃掉你。
lines.en: Don't be scared; I won't eat you all at once.
I smile, and it's a very sweet smile.
Your face is so small. Cute.
I lean in closer to smell you properly.
Can you run? I like chasing.
I reach out, then pull my hand back.

lines.zh: 你为什么不笑？笑一个嘛。
lines.en: Why aren't you smiling? Smile for me.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就跑吧，我伸展得远。
lines.en: I count to three; run, my arms stretch far.

lines.zh: 你是来陪我，还是来打我？
lines.en: Are you here to keep me company, or fight me?

lines.zh: 我舔了舔嘴唇，不好意思。
lines.en: I lick my lips. Sorry about that.
Your clothes are nice.
I look up at you, a little envious.

lines.zh: 别走呀，我才刚高兴起来。
lines.en: Don't go. I only just cheered up.

lines.zh: 我先不急着动手，你说话。
lines.en: I won't rush to hit you. Talk first.
Ouch! You hit me.

lines.zh: 我缩了一下，像被戳的气球。
lines.en: I flinch like a poked balloon.

lines.zh: 疼，但我的身体会自己合上。
lines.en: It hurts, but my body closes itself.
You broke my skin.
Now I'm unhappy.
That woke me up a bit.

lines.zh: 我退后，捂着被打的地方。
lines.en: I back off, holding where I was hit.
My blood is pink. Look.
I'm going to hit back. Don't blame me.
It hurts, it hurts, it hurts.
Is that candy? Give it, give it!
Sweet. It must be sweet.
I smell it. Don't hide it.
I've been hungry a long while. You understand.

lines.zh: 我粉色的身子，一步一蹦。
lines.en: This pink body of mine hops with every step.
Hold it as high as you like; I can still reach.

lines.zh: 身子能拉长，手臂也一样。
lines.en: This body stretches, and so do the arms.
This smell makes me happy.

lines.zh: 你要是给我，我就对你好点。
lines.en: Give it to me and I'll be nicer to you.
I'm drooling. How embarrassing.
Bumping me is like bumping dough.
Whoops, you bounced off.
I'm soft, but not light.
Don't push; I'll go out of shape.
You stepped on my foot. That hurts.

lines.zh: 我的肚子陷下去，又弹回来。
lines.en: My belly dents inward and springs right back.
I'll move aside and let you pass.

lines.zh: 你撞得不疼，就是有点痒。
lines.en: That didn't hurt, only tickled.
I've still got ash on me. Don't mind it.
Do it again. It's fun.
I don't understand that. I only understand eating.
Will you play with me a long time?

lines.zh: 我这种身体，抱起来很软吧。
lines.en: A body like mine must be soft to hold.

lines.zh: 先给我点吃的，再说别的。
lines.en: Feed me first, then we'll talk.
When I'm happy, I spin in circles.
Don't leave. I get bored alone.

lines.zh: 我记不住名字，只记得味道。
lines.en: I can't remember names, only smells.
Are we going to be friends? All right.
Do I look silly when I laugh?

lines.zh: 你要是留下，我就不吃你。
lines.en: If you stay, I won't eat you.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进嘴里，嚼了两下。
lines.en: I stuff it in my mouth and chew twice.
I grab it and go straight for my mouth.
Bleh. Not sweet.
Whatever falls is mine.
I cup it in my hands like treasure.
This thing is hard as stone.
I bite it and my teeth ache.
The safest place is my stomach.
I lick it once — bitter — and toss it away.
Picking things up is fun.
I see you! Don't hide.
You moved, so we're playing.
I've got you. Now run.
Your smell is easy to track.

lines.zh: 我笑了，这次是真的想打。
lines.en: I grin, and this time I really want to fight.
Only you? That's fine.
I've got you circled in my sight.

lines.zh: 别站着不动，那样太快结束。
lines.en: Don't stand still; that ends it too fast.
I raise a hand and a ki blast forms.

lines.zh: 我要把你变成巧克力吃掉。
lines.en: I'll turn you into chocolate and eat you.
I'm going to turn you into candy.
Big enough here for us to play.
I'm coming from above. Look up.
Don't point that at me.
Right. The chase begins.

lines.zh: 我的身体，可以拉成一条。
lines.en: My body stretches out like a rope.
One hop and I'm beside you.
My arm stretches around behind you.
I circle you as if skipping.
I can see exactly where you're going.
A bit closer. Just a bit.
The way you hold that shield is funny.

lines.zh: 我的身体可以拉成一条线。
lines.en: I can stretch my body into a line.

lines.zh: 别退到墙角，那里不好玩。
lines.en: Don't back into the corner; it's no fun there.
My ki blasts don't need aiming.
This body stretches far.

lines.zh: 我从左边来，你看着右边。
lines.en: I come from the left while you watch the right.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶落，手臂先到。
lines.en: I drop from above, arm reaching first.
You run slower than I expected.
I'll herd you into the open.
Almost. I'm so excited.
A ki wave is already in my hand.
Don't blink; you'll miss it.
One more step and we're there.
Majin fist, straight into your chest.

lines.zh: 手臂伸长了，从后面打你。
lines.en: My arm stretches and strikes from behind.

lines.zh: 我伸长手臂，把你按在墙上。
lines.en: I stretch my arm and pin you to the wall.
I strike while circling like I'm dancing.
Small ki blasts, one after another.
The ki wave drives you into the wall.
A barrage of blasts. You can't dodge them all.
My belly meets your face.

lines.zh: 我抓着你转了两圈才放。
lines.en: I swing you twice before letting go.
That one sent you flying.
You missed. I'm above your head.
Does it hurt? Me too. It's fun though.

lines.zh: 我笑得太厉害，手都抖了。
lines.en: I'm laughing so hard my hands shake.
My arm can wrap you three times.

lines.zh: 魔人拳从你背后绕过来。
lines.en: A Majin fist swings around from behind you.

lines.zh: 我收手了，你还站得住吗？
lines.en: I've stopped. Can you still stand?

lines.zh: 我从一团粉色的雾里出来。
lines.en: I come out of a cloud of pink mist.
I land and the ground dents.
So open here. Good for playing.
I open my eyes and I'm already hungry.

lines.zh: 我把头转了半圈，看看四周。
lines.en: I turn my head half around to look about.

lines.zh: 空气里有糖的味道吗？没有。
lines.en: Does the air smell of sugar? No.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，差点够到天。
lines.en: I stretch and nearly reach the sky.

lines.zh: 我站直了，比你高一头多。
lines.en: I stand up, more than a head above you.
Anyone there? Come out and play.
I pat the ash off myself.

lines.zh: 这具身体软软的，很舒服。
lines.en: This body is soft and comfortable.
I've started looking for something to eat.
Awake, so first a smile.
I sniff. There's someone living here.
I crush a brick underfoot.
A fun place. Here I come.
I tilt my head and look at this world.
Let's start. I'm waiting.
Fire makes my skin shine.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，弹了两下才停。
lines.en: I fall and bounce twice before stopping.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我肚子里全是水。
lines.en: Water pours in; my belly is full of it.
The blast blows me about like paper.

lines.zh: 箭扎进去，我拔出来看看。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in; I pull it out to look.

lines.zh: 这魔法让我的身体变硬了。
lines.en: This magic makes my body stiff.
I'm too hungry to stand straight.
Lightning strikes and I light up all over.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有东西吃，也没有东西玩。
lines.en: No food in the void, nothing to play with.
